schema.title: Portal Submission Request
schema.description: Register a piece of correspondence from the NITDA Intelligent Portal and issue a registry reference plus one upload ticket per declared attachment.

localId.description: The submitter's locally-minted provisional id, for correlation only.

category.description: Must be one of the public document-kind subset.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the file, or empty when the browser could not compute one.

verification.description: A single-use proof from Verify Confirm. Only checked when the flow is configured to require it.

equals: @and(greater(length(outputs('Compose_Subject')), 5), greater(length(outputs('Compose_Description')), 19), greater(length(outputs('Compose_Sender_Name')), 1), and(contains(outputs('Compose_Sender_Email'), '@'), equals(indexOf(outputs('Compose_Sender_Email'), '@'), lastIndexOf(outputs('Compose_Sender_Email'), '@')), greater(indexOf(outputs('Compose_Sender_Email'), '@'), 0), less(indexOf(outputs('Compose_Sender_Email'), '@'), sub(length(outputs('Compose_Sender_Email')), 3)), contains(substring(outputs('Compose_Sender_Email'), add(indexOf(outputs('Compose_Sender_Email'), '@'), 1)), '.'), not(contains(outputs('Compose_Sender_Email'), ' '))), contains(createArray('General Correspondence', 'Application', 'Proposal', 'Report', 'Compliance Filing', 'Policy Submission', 'Event Invitation'), outputs('Compose_Category')), greater(length(outputs('Compose_Attachments')), 0), lessOrEquals(length(outputs('Compose_Attachments')), 5), equals(length(outputs('Filter_Valid_Attachments')?['body']), length(outputs('Compose_Attachments'))))
